title: Return a whole number
summary: Solidity: Return a whole number. Add 6 and 4.
introduction: uint256 stores a nonnegative whole number. Call answer() to add two small counts.
learningObjectives: Return a whole number with Solidity

blocks.text: Paste one contract into Remix and choose compiler 0.8.24 or later in the 0.8 series. Deploy only to Remix VM for practice. Call the function named in the lesson; shown results are return values.

blocks.title: Return a whole number

blocks.text: The pure function adds two uint256 values and returns 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Unsigned numbers cannot represent negative values.
